# jaff.core.network.config

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Config of the network (`[network]`) and of a `jaff.toml` file.

`NetworkConfig` lists the models of the modules it configures as its
fields.  A network's `jaff.toml` lives next to its network file
(`jaff_toml_for`); `load_network_config` stacks it under the
caller's config layers.

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |

| [`NetworkConfig`](networkconfig/index.md) | Network (`[network]`). |

## Functions

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |

| [`load_network_config`](load_network_config.md) | Load a network's config: *defaults* < jaff.toml < *config* layers < *overrides*. |
